requirements.requirement: Downstream-only, reusable N-block pipeline; no raw processing or study constants.
Keyed source/feature/sample/subject identity and arbitrary block labels/counts.
Faithful source-role/conversion, authoritative pairing and clinical linkage.
Immutable quantity/mask/preprocessing/state provenance and method-specific order.
Train-only fit/apply, no held-out refit or leakage through feature selection.
Explicit evidence-qualified missingness/normalization without assay-wide assumptions.
Lipid structural resolution, fixed parent quantities and compositional interpretation.
Declared estimands and same representation within Analysis/context, not across incompatible questions.
Correct per-feature model/rank/uncertainty and repeated design eligibility.
Fixed per-block/claim multiplicity, failed-member accounting and no union-FDR claim.
Count-provenance and qualified DEqMS rather than automatic count-triggered substitution.
Effect units, directional consistency applicability and non-equivalent sensitivity tests.
Leakage-safe matched nested evaluation and explicitly limited prediction claims.
Protected six-field common integration and honest native/projection variance/score semantics.
Actual PCA/PLS, DIABLO, continuous block.spls and MOFA capabilities with native checks.
Typed clinical dictionaries, observations/objectives and source/privacy/coverage.
B-owned eligible clinical associations, time/covariate/missingness rules, no silent fallback.
Score training/selection/unit lineage and distinction from independent validation.
Conditional matched clinical-only/molecular-only/combined predictive evaluation.
Both B/C annotation routes, full evidence, safe unavailable states and no upstream refit.
Namespace/taxon/resolution mapping and valid enrichment universes/method meaning.
Imported/selected evidence isolation and explicit selection/overlap validity.
Target assess/compare/discover; metabolism never certifies binding, flux or causality.
Target alternative/contradictory/ambiguous evidence and no double-counted replication.
Release/hash/operation-specific rights, offline policy and no private external upload.
Safe local report, clinical disclosure controls and no public participant-level data.
Substantive oracle/null/weak/adversarial/missingness/calibration tests, not fake validation.
Real environment lock, atomic artifacts, cache invalidation, restart and reproducibility.
Honest scope, status, reporting, conditional capability and final close accounting.
